survivalfly.title: Survival Fly
survivalfly.gui.update_available: A newer version of Survival Fly is available
survivalfly.options.enable_mod.descripti:
Enables the Survival Fly mod (for your client/singleplayer/LAN worlds).

§cPlease note that this mod is not a hack/cheat, it only works if this mod is installed on the server-side.
survivalfly.options.crouch_flight.descri:
Allows crouching while flying without descending (CTRL + SHIFT).

§cThis feature §c§odoes work on servers §r§cthat don't have the mod installed, but please be careful and read the server rules before using this feature.
survivalfly.options.safe_mode.descriptio:
Prevents joining servers that do not have this mod installed.

§cPlease note that this mod is §c§lnot a hack, §r§f§cand only works on servers that have this mod installed. You should not attempt to cheat on a server with this mod.
survivalfly.options.client.description: Configure client-side options for Survival Fly.
survivalfly.options.server_warnings.desc: Sends warning messages to the player upon joining a server that does not have Survival Fly installed.
survivalfly.options.menu_button.descript:
Determines where the Survival Fly menu button should display.

Everywhere → §7in the default position on the pause screen and title screen§r§f

Title Only → §7only on the title screen§r§f

OFF → §7do not display the menu button at all. You should only disable this if you have another way of accessing the menu, via Mod Menu or (Neo)Forge's mod list.
survivalfly.options.singleplayer.descrip: Configure settings for singleplayer/LAN worlds. Use commands to configure settings for servers.
survivalfly.options.permissions.descript:
Choose who can use /flight commands

This only applies if you are hosting a singleplayer world. To change the permissions on a server, use the /permissions command or install §aLuckPerms§r§f.

§aAnyone → §7anyone can use /flight§r§f

§dModerator → §7players that bypass spawn protection can use /flight§r§f

§5Gamemaster → §7players that have higher authority, such as permission to use command blocks, change gamemode, change difficulty, etc. can use /flight§r§f

§cAdmin → §7only operators can use /flight. Admins can also change the flight of others
survivalfly.options.friendly_flight.desc:
Prevents the player from using flight if they have taken any damage within 20 seconds.

§bPlayers §r§f& §r§aMobs §r§f→ §7prevent flight from player and mob damage§r§f

§aPlayers Only §r§f→ §7prevent flight from player damage
survivalfly.options.elytra_flight.descri: Requires the player to wear an elytra to use flight. The elytra's durability will decrement based on the player's flight speed.
survivalfly.options.flight_exhaustion.de: Makes the player hungry when using flight.
survivalfly.toast.yacl: Please download YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) to configure Survival Fly.
survivalfly.not_installed:
§cUnable to fetch the Survival Fly mod on this server.§r§f
§aTo join this server, disable the "Safe Mode" option in Survival Fly options.
§r§fPlease note: §o§cthis mod is §c§lnot a hack, §r§f§oand only works on servers that have this mod installed.
survivalfly.crouch_flight_disabled: §cWarning: Survival Fly is not installed on this server, therefor, §c§l"Crouch Flight" §r§f§chas been automatically disabled for your safety.
